selection_protocol.inner: leave one of the four remaining benchmarks out; select on 20 inner target-seed trials
selection_protocol.exact: maximum mean inner learned gain versus matched LP
selection_protocol.one_se_safe: among configurations within one SE of exact, prefer lower gamma and smoother source mixing

notes: Two-way residual labels remove source-specific action priors and per-prompt common difficulty before Ridge fitting.
Source priors and residual experts are combined only by unlabeled prompt-embedding centroid similarity.
Gamma zero is an explicit abstention option equal to the matched static LP.
The coarse inner lambda grid is used only for hyperparameter selection; final outer policies use the full Exp25 lambda grid.
